_comment: NovaSVG supported-language registry - drives the tab bar + tab content of
docs/index.html.in (see docs/generate_index.py, invoked by docs/CreateDocs.cmake).
Order here is the display order everywhere: CLI is pinned first (it's the
tool most users reach for first), the rest are alphabetical by display name.
Each entry's 'folder' must contain three fragment files:
<folder>/index-docs.json    - structured API-reference card fields
(title, badge, description, meta_icon,
meta_label, link_href, link_label)
<folder>/index-install.txt  - raw HTML for the install panel
<folder>/index-example.txt  - raw HTML for the quick-example panel
role (optional, default 'binding') decides how an entry is counted in the
hero/footer text that generate_index.py derives from this file:
'tool'    - not a language (CLI): gets tabs, but is left out of every list
'core'    - the C++ core: listed as a supported language, but not counted
as a binding
'binding' - a language binding (everything else)
So adding a language here is enough; the hero eyebrow, the 'APIs for ...'
sentence, the binding count and the footer tagline all follow.
icon.kind is 'fa' (a Font Awesome class string) or 'svg' (a named inline
glyph resolved by generate_index.py's ICON_SVG dict - currently only
'layers', the generic block/document glyph used for C++, which has
no suitable brand icon in Font Awesome's free set).
